title: Layered Taco Dip with Meat
description: This layered taco-dip with taco-seasoned meat, cheese, sour cream, lettuce, and salsa proves that appetizers can sometimes take the place of a meal!
ingredients: 2 (1.25 ounce) packages mild taco seasoning mix (such as McCormick®), divided
1 (8 ounce) package shredded Cheddar cheese, divided
1 (8 ounce) jar salsa, or to taste

steps.text: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef; cook and stir until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard grease, then stir in one package of the taco seasoning mix. Let beef cool completely.
While the beef is cooling, stir sour cream, cream cheese, and remaining taco seasoning mix together in a bowl until smooth. Spread over the bottom of a baking dish to cover.
Sprinkle about 1/2 of the Cheddar over the sour cream. Layer with seasoned ground beef, lettuce, and remaining Cheddar. Spoon salsa over the dip. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.
